description: Bushaltes De Lijn Gent is a dataset listed in Open Data Portaal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by De Lijn. In deze dataset kan je de locaties terugvinden van de verschillende bushaltes op Gents grondgebied die worden bediend door De Lijn. In deze data kan je ook de toegankelijkheidsinformatie vinden van de desbetreffende bushaltes. Deze data is afkomstig van het Open Dataportaal van De Lijn:. Coverage: Ghent. The portal files it under Mobiliteit. Its keywords are Openbaar vervoer, Toegankelijkheid. The portal shows 1,468 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Modellicentie Gratis Hergebruik (https://www.vlaanderen.be/digitaal-vlaanderen/onze-oplossingen/open-data/voorwaarden-voor-het-hergebruik-van-overheidsinformatie/modellicentie-gratis-hergebruik). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-stad-gent-portal.
